candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record and pathology (CD56+ intravascular atypical cells) support intravascular NK/T-cell lymphoma, nasal type. C001 correctly identifies the intravascular lymphoma category and cutaneous presentation but does not specify the NK/T-cell lineage or nasal type subtype, which are required components of the benchmark reference diagnosis.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Identifies intravascular lymphoma with cutaneous involvement but omits the required NK/T-cell lineage specification and 'nasal type' designation

case_quality_flags: CD56 positivity on immunostaining is the key discriminator for NK/T-cell lineage; B-cell intravascular lymphoma would be the more common differential and is not excluded by the candidate label alone
